params.prompt: Photorealistic restaurant menu food photograph, 3/4 angle from slightly above. One large handmade corn tortilla taco on a paper tray lined with green-and-white checkered paper: hummus spread on the tortilla, crisp falafel, mixed greens, cucumber salad, a drizzle of pale green cilantro aioli, and a generous heap of thin shredded bright pink pickled red onions on top. The food sits on the red-painted wooden counter of a walk-up food stand in Los Angeles. Bright natural afternoon sunlight with crisp soft shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field; background softly blurred warm red and brick tones with a hint of colorful cut-paper banners. Tack-sharp focus, true-to-life textures and natural color, appetizing, real street-food look, not over-styled. No text, no logos, no labels, no people, no hands.
